Internal helper: the vector path's collision with a data frame's variable

Source: R/checks.R
dot-jst_vector_collision.Rd

Ruling R18 (Session 355; built Session 356), ruling R12's other half. jdesc(Age) with no data frame named and none set – or a default that has no Age – reads the workspace object Age and says nothing, while a data frame in the workspace holds the variable the user may have meant. When the expression read is a name (Age, (Age), .GlobalEnv$Age) and a data frame the caller can see has a variable of that name, a note is attached to the one-column frame the re-call analyzes, and .jst_vector_note() prints it under the title: which object was read, and the call that reads the variable, naming the one frame that has it, or MyData when several do. A copy of the column is read as it is: the frame's stored settings and registrations do not reach a copy. Declined (Jeff, S355): a scan at load time; a note on every vector analysis.

Usage

.jst_vector_collision(wrapped, envir, fn_name)

.jst_vector_note(data)

Arguments

wrapped

The .jst_vector_frame() result.

envir

The caller's environment.

fn_name

Character(1); the user-facing function's name.

data

The data frame the re-call received.

Value

wrapped, its frame carrying the note when one applies.
